column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable tombstone .gone/<key>. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole object); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole object is unreadable: the neighbour does not drop the copy, the deleter does not append confirmations and does not remove the tombstone — an unknown outcome is not a confirmation (the tombstones contract garbled); the cause goes to the pass log
